'''"With You"''' is a song by American singer [[Chris Brown]] for his second studio album, ''[[Exclusive (album)|Exclusive]]'' (2007). The song was written by [[Johntá Austin]], [[Espionage (production team)|Espionage]], and [[Stargate (production team)|Stargate]], the latter of which produced the song. The song was released as the album's third single on December 4, 2007, in the United States. It was later released internationally on March 21, 2008. "With You" is composed as a [[midtempo]] [[Contemporary R&B|R&B]] [[ballad]] that features an acoustic guitar as the base of the arrangement.

"With You" topped the charts in New Zealand and peaked inside the top five in several countries. In the United States, "With You" peaked at number two on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] and at number one on the US [[Pop Songs]] chart. Among its certifications, the song is certified Sextuple Platinum in the US and Quadruple Platinum in Australia. The music video for "With You" was directed by Brown and [[Erik White]]. The video focuses more on Brown and his dance moves while utilizing several visual effects. It won the accolade for "[[MTV Video Music Award for Best Male Video|Best Male Video]]" at the [[2008 MTV Video Music Awards]].

"With You" is a song by American singer Chris Brown for his second studio album, Exclusive (2007). The song was written by Johntá Austin, Espionage, and Stargate, the latter of which produced the song. The song was released as the album's third single on December 4, 2007, in the United States. It was later released internationally on March 21, 2008. "With You" is composed as a midtempo R&B ballad that features an acoustic guitar as the base of the arrangement.

"With You" topped the charts in New Zealand and peaked inside the top five in several countries. In the United States, "With You" peaked at number two on the Billboard Hot 100 and at number one on the US Pop Songs chart. Among its certifications, the song is certified Sextuple Platinum in the US and Quadruple Platinum in Australia. The music video for "With You" was directed by Brown and Erik White. The video focuses more on Brown and his dance moves while utilizing several visual effects. It won the accolade for "Best Male Video" at the 2008 MTV Video Music Awards.

sections.heading: Background and release
sections.wikitext:
"With You" was written by [[Johntá Austin]], Mikkel S. Eriksen, Tor Erik Hermansen, [[Espen Lind]], and Amund Bjørklund.<ref name="Exclusive"/> Eriksen and Hermansen produced the song under their production stage-name Stargate. Eriksen recorded it at Battery Studios - a recording studio in New York.<ref name="Exclusive"/> [[Phil Tan]] mixed the track with assistance from Josh Houghkirk at Soapbox Studio in [[Atlanta]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]].<ref name="Exclusive"/> Eriksen and Hermansen, in addition to producing and writing, performed all the instruments featured on the song, with the exception of the guitar, which was provided by Lind.

"With You" was released as the third single from Brown's second studio album ''[[Exclusive (album)|Exclusive]]'' (2007), after "[[Wall to Wall (song)|Wall to Wall]]" and "[[Kiss Kiss (Chris Brown song)|Kiss Kiss]]" (2007). Before its official single release, the song was first released to digital retailers in certain territories on November 2, 2007, through Zomba Recordings, as a promotional single.<ref name="Austria release"/> More than a month later, on December 4, 2007, [[Jive Records]] and [[Zomba Group|Zomba Recordings]] serviced the song to rhythmic crossover radio in the United States. They later solicited to contemporary hit radio on January 8, 2008.<ref name="airplay">{{cite web|url=http://www.fmqb.com/Article.asp?id=69239|title=Airplay Archive|work=[[FMQB]]|publisher=Friday Morning Quarterback Album Report, Inc. and Mediaspan Online Services|access-date=November 30, 2011|archive-date=February 20, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170220231440/http://www.fmqb.com/Article.asp?id=69239|url-status=dead}}</ref> On March 4, 2008, an extended play for "With You" was released to digital retailers in certain countries, including the United States, featuring the original song and two other remixes by Tracy Young and [[Kovas]].<ref name="Brazil release"/> Another extended play was released in selected countries on March 14, 2008, containing the original version and four other remixes.<ref name="Australia release"/> On March 21, 2008, "With You" was released as a digital single in several countries, including Belgium, France, Ireland and Norway. The single featured a B-side, the B&B Remix of "With You".<ref name=Single/>

Speaking about the track, Brown said to [[MTV News]]: "When I heard the song for the first time, it touched me immediately. Therefore it was really easy for me to put my personal feelings and experiences inside it. I think that the secret of the track is that everyone can identify themselves with it no matter how old you are."<ref name="v1019.com">{{cite web | url=https://v1019.com/galleries/10-of-chris-browns-best-songs-ranked/ | title=10 of Chris Brown's Best Songs Ranked | date=May 5, 2022 }}</ref>

"With You" was written by Johntá Austin, Mikkel S. Eriksen, Tor Erik Hermansen, Espen Lind, and Amund Bjørklund. Eriksen and Hermansen produced the song under their production stage-name Stargate. Eriksen recorded it at Battery Studios - a recording studio in New York. Phil Tan mixed the track with assistance from Josh Houghkirk at Soapbox Studio in Atlanta, Georgia. Eriksen and Hermansen, in addition to producing and writing, performed all the instruments featured on the song, with the exception of the guitar, which was provided by Lind.

"With You" was released as the third single from Brown's second studio album Exclusive (2007), after "Wall to Wall" and "Kiss Kiss" (2007). Before its official single release, the song was first released to digital retailers in certain territories on November 2, 2007, through Zomba Recordings, as a promotional single. More than a month later, on December 4, 2007, Jive Records and Zomba Recordings serviced the song to rhythmic crossover radio in the United States. They later solicited to contemporary hit radio on January 8, 2008. On March 4, 2008, an extended play for "With You" was released to digital retailers in certain countries, including the United States, featuring the original song and two other remixes by Tracy Young and Kovas. Another extended play was released in selected countries on March 14, 2008, containing the original version and four other remixes. On March 21, 2008, "With You" was released as a digital single in several countries, including Belgium, France, Ireland and Norway. The single featured a B-side, the B&B Remix of "With You".

Speaking about the track, Brown said to MTV News: "When I heard the song for the first time, it touched me immediately. Therefore it was really easy for me to put my personal feelings and experiences inside it. I think that the secret of the track is that everyone can identify themselves with it no matter how old you are."

sections.heading: Composition
sections.wikitext: [[File:Chris Brown singing at Brisbane Entertainment Centre cropped 2.jpg|thumb|upright=0.7|[[Chris Brown]] (''pictured'') collaborated with record producing team [[Stargate (record producers)|Stargate]] on "With You".]] "With You" is a "[[Folk music|folksy]]" mid-tempo [[Contemporary R&B|R&B]] ballad.<ref name="digital spy"/> According to the sheet music published at Musicnotes.com by [[Sony/ATV Music Publishing]], "With You" is set in the key of [[E-flat major|E♭ major]] with a moderate tempo. Brown's vocals range from E♭<sub>4</sub> to B♭<sub>5</sub>.<ref name="sheet music">{{cite web|title=Chris Brown - With You Sheet Music (Digital Download)|url=http://www.musicnotes.com/sheetmusic/mtdFPE.asp?ppn=MN0062763&|work=Musicnotes.com| date=February 2008 |publisher=[[Sony/ATV Music Publishing]]|access-date=July 3, 2012}}</ref> The song's instrumental consists of a slow stuttering [[Hip hop music|hip hop]] drum beat and an [[acoustic guitar]] arrangement that garnered comparisons to other Stargate produced songs for artists such as [[Ne-Yo]], [[Beyoncé]] and [[Rihanna]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Stewart|first=Allison|title=Chris Brown, Seeking an Age-Appropriate Sound|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2007/11/05/AR2007110502068.html|newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]|access-date=July 7, 2012|date=November 6, 2007}}</ref><ref name=sanneh/><ref name="digital spy"/><ref>{{cite web|last=Kot|first=Greg|title=Chris Brown has charisma, but hasn't grown into his own sound yet|url=http://leisureblogs.chicagotribune.com/turn_it_up/2007/12/chris-brown-has.html|work=[[Chicago Tribune]]|access-date=July 7, 2012|date=December 4, 2007}}</ref> Lyrically, "With You" is about [[romantic love]], presented in a [[Adolescence|teenage]] context.<ref name="harvard crimson"/>
sections.text: thumb|upright=0.7|[[Chris Brown (pictured) collaborated with record producing team Stargate on "With You".]] "With You" is a "folksy" mid-tempo R&B ballad. According to the sheet music published at Musicnotes.com by Sony/ATV Music Publishing, "With You" is set in the key of E♭ major with a moderate tempo. Brown's vocals range from E♭<sub>4</sub> to B♭<sub>5</sub>. The song's instrumental consists of a slow stuttering hip hop drum beat and an acoustic guitar arrangement that garnered comparisons to other Stargate produced songs for artists such as Ne-Yo, Beyoncé and Rihanna. Lyrically, "With You" is about romantic love, presented in a teenage context.

sections.heading: Music video
sections.wikitext:
The [[music video]] was shot in [[Los Angeles, California]] on November 20, 2007. It premiered on music video channels [[MTV]], [[Black Entertainment Television|BET]], and [[Fuse TV]] during the week of December 3, 2007. In a November 8, 2007, interview with MTV, Brown stated that he co-directed the video as well. "And it shows me more solo. Like, it shows the grown side of Chris – it doesn't show the kiddie side. 'Cause with this album, I wanted to blend, I wanted to do all different visuals of me. The first [video] 'Wall to Wall,' the acting, the vampires, the spookiness, then you go to 'Kiss, Kiss,' that had the little goofy part, now this one is solo, the main [performer] is me. Me freestyle dancing – just showing people me naturally, not a choreographed routine, just me dancing and showing you what I'm capable of. But at the same time, I was just having fun with the camera, and just one-on-one time with me and my audience."<ref name=MTV>Jayson Rodriguez, Yasmine Richard (November 8, 2007). {{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130129083843/http://www.mtv.com/news/articles/1573840/20071108/brown__chris__18_.jhtml|title=Kanye West Put A Stop To Chris Brown's Graduation Plans}} ''MTV''. Accessed December 5, 2007.</ref> The video was quite popular in American television, reaching number 1 on [[Black Entertainment Television|BET]]'s ''[[106 & Park]]'' for 6 days, and staying on the countdown for 38 days. It has also reached number 1 on [[MTV]]'s ''[[Total Request Live|TRL]]'' for 10 days, replacing Flo Rida's "Low" and finally retired at number 1 after it stayed on the countdown for 35 days. The music video won the accolade for "[[MTV Video Music Award for Best Male Video|Best Male Video]]" at the 2008 MTV Video Music Awards.<ref name=vma>{{cite web|title=MTV Video Music Awards (2008)|url=http://www.mtv.com/ontv/vma/2008/|archive-url=https://archive.today/20090424021050/http://www.mtv.com/ontv/vma/2008/|url-status=dead|archive-date=April 24, 2009|work=[[MTV]]|publisher=[[Viacom (2005–present)|Viacom International Inc]]|access-date=July 2, 2012}}</ref>

The music video on [[YouTube]] has received over 700 million views as of August 2024.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nmjdaBaZe8Y Chris Brown - With You (Official HD Video)].[[YouTube]]</ref>

sections.heading: Critical reception
sections.wikitext:
The song received critical acclaim.  Lamb of ''[[About.com]]'' awarded a four and a half star rating, praising the song's "instant warmth of the guitar-based arrangement", "Brown's romantic vocals" and as a perfect slow dance option. Lamb however disregarded its "simplistic swoony lyrics". He concluded his review, saying ""With You" helps prove that Chris Brown is not only an amazingly talented dancer, he can truly communicate to an audience vocally as well. Look for this song as a key choice at romantic events throughout 2008 and beyond."<ref name=Lamb>{{cite web|last=Lamb|first=Bill|title=Chris Brown - With You|url=http://top40.about.com/od/singles/gr/chrisbrownwith.htm|work=[[About.com]]|publisher=[[The New York Times Company]]|access-date=July 5, 2012|archive-date=September 24, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924054738/http://top40.about.com/od/singles/gr/chrisbrownwith.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref> Erinn V. Westbrook of ''[[The Harvard Crimson]]'' wrote positively about the single, saying "It’s a bit sappy, but Brown comes off surprisingly genuine. If you’re like me, you may actually fall in love with the teenage vocalist."<ref name="harvard crimson">{{cite web|last=Westbrook|first=Erinn V.|title=Chris Brown|url=http://www.thecrimson.com/article/2007/11/9/chris-brown-look-out-michael-jackson/|work=[[The Harvard Crimson]]|publisher=The Harvard Crimson, Inc|access-date=July 2, 2012|date=November 9, 2007}}</ref> In 2022 [[WBAV-FM|V101.9]] ranked the song at number eight among Chris Brown's best singles.<ref name="v1019.com"/> ''[[The Boombox]]'' called "With You" a "defining song in [Brown's] career", stating that it displayed "how he could capture an audience with his dance and vocal skills".<ref>{{cite web | url=https://theboombox.com/20-chris-brown-songs-that-made-you-a-fan/ | title=20 Chris Brown Songs That Made You a Fan | date=December 15, 2015 }}</ref>

Andy Kellman of ''[[Allmusic]]'' named it one of the album's highlights.<ref>{{cite web|last=Kellman|first=Andy|title=Exclusive - Chris Brown|url=http://www.allmusic.com/album/exclusive-mw0000578152|work=[[Allmusic]]|publisher=[[Rovi Corporation]]|access-date=July 2, 2012}}</ref> Nick Levine of [[Digital Spy]] gave the song a three star rating, calling it a "pretty, folk-tinged R&B ballad" and commenting that "The lyrics won't be troubling the Ivor Novello judges any time soon ("With every kiss and every hug, you make me fall in love"), but its chorus is pretty enough to make us turn a deaf ear."<ref name="digital spy">{{cite web|last=Levine|first=Nick|title=Chris Brown: 'With You' - Music Singles Review|url=http://www.digitalspy.com/music/singlesreviews/a90298/chris-brown-with-you.html|work=[[Digital Spy]]|publisher=Hearst Magazines UK|access-date=July 3, 2012|date=February 27, 2008}}</ref> [[Kelefa Sanneh]] of ''[[The New York Times]]'' commented that song borrows "brazenly" from Beyonce's 2006 single "[[Irreplaceable]]".<ref name=sanneh>{{cite news|last=Sanneh|first=Kelefa|title=CD Review: Chris Brown grows up|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=BnZSAAAAIBAJ&pg=3877,4200797&dq=chris+brown+exclusive&hl=en|access-date=July 6, 2012|newspaper=[[Ocala Star-Banner]]|date=November 8, 2007}}</ref><ref name=mayers>{{cite web|last=Mayers|first=Norman|title=Album Review: Chris Brown - Exclusive|url=http://www.prefixmag.com/reviews/chris-brown/exclusive/16544/|work=Prefix|access-date=July 6, 2012|date=March 28, 2008}}</ref> Sal Cinquemani of ''[[Slant Magazine]]'' commented that Stargate already used the same production formula on several songs before "With You", saying that it "is in serious need of replacing".<ref name=slant>{{cite web|last=Cinquemani|first=Sal|title=Chris Brown: Exclusive|url=http://www.slantmagazine.com/music/review/chris-brown-exclusive/1213|work=[[Slant Magazine]]|access-date=July 7, 2012|date=November 6, 2007}}</ref> ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' wrote favorably of the song, saying that Brown on the song is "laying impressionable lyrics over Stargate’s guitar plucks".<ref>{{cite magazine | url=https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/chris-browns-20-biggest-billboard-hits-6251630/ | title=Chris Brown's 20 Biggest Billboard Hits | magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]] }}</ref>
sections.text:
The song received critical acclaim.  Lamb of About.com awarded a four and a half star rating, praising the song's "instant warmth of the guitar-based arrangement", "Brown's romantic vocals" and as a perfect slow dance option. Lamb however disregarded its "simplistic swoony lyrics". He concluded his review, saying ""With You" helps prove that Chris Brown is not only an amazingly talented dancer, he can truly communicate to an audience vocally as well. Look for this song as a key choice at romantic events throughout 2008 and beyond." Erinn V. Westbrook of The Harvard Crimson wrote positively about the single, saying "It’s a bit sappy, but Brown comes off surprisingly genuine. If you’re like me, you may actually fall in love with the teenage vocalist." In 2022 V101.9 ranked the song at number eight among Chris Brown's best singles. The Boombox called "With You" a "defining song in [Brown's] career", stating that it displayed "how he could capture an audience with his dance and vocal skills".

Andy Kellman of Allmusic named it one of the album's highlights. Nick Levine of Digital Spy gave the song a three star rating, calling it a "pretty, folk-tinged R&B ballad" and commenting that "The lyrics won't be troubling the Ivor Novello judges any time soon ("With every kiss and every hug, you make me fall in love"), but its chorus is pretty enough to make us turn a deaf ear." Kelefa Sanneh of The New York Times commented that song borrows "brazenly" from Beyonce's 2006 single "Irreplaceable". Sal Cinquemani of Slant Magazine commented that Stargate already used the same production formula on several songs before "With You", saying that it "is in serious need of replacing". Billboard wrote favorably of the song, saying that Brown on the song is "laying impressionable lyrics over Stargate’s guitar plucks".

sections.heading: Chart performance
sections.text:
"With You" debuted at number 72 on the Billboard Hot 100 in the issue dated December 15, 2007, earning the biggest debut title for the week. In the song's seventh week, it entered the top ten tier of the chart, ascending from number twelve in the previous week to number six. Three weeks later, in the issue dated February 16, 2008, "With You" peaked at number two the Billboard Hot 100, where it remained for four consecutive weeks. On March 15, 2008, the song fell to number three, but ascended to number two the succeeding week, where it remained for another week, this time blocked by Usher's "Love in This Club" featuring Young Jeezy. The song also topped the US Radio Songs and the US Pop Songs charts as well as peaking at number five on the US Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart. It was certified platinum on April 24, 2008, by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) for selling one million downloads. In Canada, "With You" entered the Canadian Hot 100 as the chart's highest debut at number 70 in the issue dated January 5, 2008. Ten weeks later, the song peaked at number two, where it remained for two weeks. On March 26, 2008, it was certified gold by Music Canada for selling 20,000 ringtones.

"With You" debuted on the Australian Singles Chart at number 24 on the issue dated March 16, 2008. The song quickly ascended the chart, reaching its peak at number five in its fifth week, where it remained for two weeks. "Kiss Kiss" was later certified double platinum by the Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) for shipping 140,000 copies. In New Zealand, the song entered the singles chart at number 25 on the issue dated December 17, 2007. Three weeks later, the song entered the top five, ascending to number four. In the issue dated February 18, 2008, "With You" topped the New Zealand Top 40, where it remained for four weeks. It remained on the chart for a total of twenty-three weeks. The song was certified platinum on March 16, 2008, by the Recording Industry Association of New Zealand (RIANZ). "With You" debuted on the UK Singles Chart at number 100 in the issue dated February 2, 2008. It eventually peaked at number eight on the week ending April 5, 2008, and remained on the singles chart for a total of thirty-six weeks. On August 22, 2008, "With You" was certified silver by the British Phonographic Industry (BPI) for selling 200,000 copies.
